newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week's close, USDA said.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 74.00-81.25; 700-800 lbs 74.50-77.50, pkg blacks 763 lbs 79.75; 800-900 lbs 12 head blacks 863 lbs 74.75. Holsteins - Large 2 500-600 lbs 62.50-66.75.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 66.50-74.75; 700-800 lbs 67.00-69.00. Medium and Large 2 400-500 lbs 67.00-72.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,700
